clauses.text: 1. Recitals

source_location.excerpt: 1. Recitals

clauses.text: This Agreement governs the supply, installation, and ongoing support of secure financial transaction devices, high-performance servers, and networking infrastructure to support Client’s BFSI operations.

source_location.excerpt: This Agreement governs the supply, installation, and ongoing support of secure financial transaction devices, high-performance servers, and networking infrastructure to support Client’s BFSI operations.

clauses.text: 2. Definitions

source_location.excerpt: 2. Definitions

clauses.text: “Hardware”: Servers, network switches, secure ATMs, and transaction devices specified in Annexure A.

source_location.excerpt: “Hardware”: Servers, network switches, secure ATMs, and transaction devices specified in Annexure A.

clauses.text: “Integration Services”: Vendor’s services to install, configure, and integrate Hardware with Client’s IT infrastructure.

source_location.excerpt: “Integration Services”: Vendor’s services to install, configure, and integrate Hardware with Client’s IT infrastructure.

clauses.text: “Acceptance”: Successful completion of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) at Client site.

source_location.excerpt: “Acceptance”: Successful completion of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) at Client site.

clauses.text: 3. Scope of Supply

source_location.excerpt: 3. Scope of Supply

clauses.text:
3.1 Vendor shall supply Hardware per Annexure A specifications.
3.2 Vendor shall conduct integration services and provide 3 weeks of on-site training.
3.3 Vendor shall implement cybersecurity configurations, including firewall and encryption protocols.
3.4 Vendor shall provide quarterly preventive maintenance and firmware updates.

source_location.excerpt:
3.1 Vendor shall supply Hardware per Annexure A specifications.
3.2 Vendor shall conduct integration services and provide 3 weeks of on-site training.
3.3 Vendor shall implement cybersecurity configurations, including firewall and encryption protocols.
3.4 Vendor shall provide quarterly preventive maintenance and firmware updates.

5.2 On-site technical support within 24 hours for mission-critical devices.
5.3 Replacement of faulty Hardware within 7 business days.

7.2 Vendor shall encrypt all data transmitted to and from Hardware.
7.3 Confidentiality obligations continue for 5 years post-termination.

clauses.text: 8. Liability and Indemnification

source_location.excerpt: 8. Liability and Indemnification

clauses.text:
8.1 Vendor shall indemnify Client for claims arising from hardware defects or gross negligence.
8.2 Vendor’s total liability capped at contract value; excludes indirect or consequential losses.
8.3 Vendor responsible for data loss caused by Vendor’s equipment malfunction; Client requested explicit inclusion of business interruption coverage.

9.3 Termination for convenience requires 90 days’ notice and payment for delivered and installed Hardware.
